label: A schema model has nonempty global GOD_4/founding antecedents, attestation, veracity, Catholic-only…
paraphrase: A schema model has nonempty global God/founding antecedents, attestation, veracity, Catholic-only mandate scope including teaching, and envoy transfer, while the universal divine-founding bridge, universal scope and stage6 identity fail. This coarse target does not export that the founded body is Catholic or identify a distinct other body. Its concrete two-society construction has those properties; CATHOLIC-AND-DISTINCT-BODY-SCOPE-COUNTERMODEL separately certifies them explicitly. This is not an actual-world refutation or a challenge to the existing weak-plus-stage6 composition.
